caption: The drawing features two representations of a long-handled tool, depicted side by side on an off-white background. Both handles are light brown, appear to be made of wood, and taper slightly toward the top. The tool head consists of a cylindrical metallic container, colored in shades of gray and brown, mounted at the end of the wooden pole. The container is held in place by two curved metallic supports that wrap partially around the cylinder. Extending vertically from the top of the cylinder is a narrow neck with a dark tip, which may serve as a wick or nozzle. The larger depiction on the right shows a close-up of the tool head and part of the handle, while the left depiction shows the tool in its entirety, maintaining the same proportions but at a smaller scale. There are faint blue handwritten notes on the background, and the artist’s signature appears in the lower right corner with the date "1937."
title: Election Torch
